frase_inicial: Michael: vamos paso a paso — one small money check first

tarjetas.frente: Cash for the January home and cushion
tarjetas.reverso: If you hold the down‑payment and vacation money separately, your everyday cash stops being pulled between the house and bills.
tarjetas.detalle: $113,300 for home down payment Jan 2027; $3,500 vacation Jan 2027. Current cash $30,000.

tarjetas.reverso: Today’s saving pace leaves some planned spending unpaid later, so we should choose what to protect first: retirement or the home.
tarjetas.detalle: Retirement gap: plan estimates additional $20,231/year needed; savings projected to run out at age 85.

tarjetas.frente: Life and liability protection need attention
tarjetas.reverso: Your life cover and lack of extra liability leave your income and assets less shielded; confirming existing policies is a simple next check.
tarjetas.detalle: Current life cover $180,000; recommended range much higher. No umbrella shown in data.

tarjetas.frente: High‑cost credit card is costing you
tarjetas.reverso: That card is the most expensive debt; keeping its payments steady avoids interest piling up while you sort cash for the home.
tarjetas.detalle: Credit card balance $3,500 at 20% APR, $200 monthly payment, projected payoff Jul 2028.

tarjetas.frente: Your saving habit is a strength
tarjetas.reverso: You already save steadily and capture the employer match; that habit is the tool to rebuild cash or boost retirement once priorities are set.
tarjetas.detalle: Annual savings $43,000 including $7,000 employer match; 401(k) contributions $17,000 of $24,500 limit.

movimientos.title: Add umbrella cover
movimientos.action: Add $1M of umbrella to raise the liability shield

movimientos.title: Lower the withdrawal rate
movimientos.action: Cutting withdrawals to $10,300/year (6.0%) reaches the sustainable band

movimientos.title: Raise growth allocation toward glide
movimientos.action: Move the invested mix from 74% to 88% growth (glide 98%) for the next horizon-fit band — about $19,900 of the invested book

mapa.aviso: Illustrative simulator: it shows the direction of change, not a Sherpas projection.

siguiente_paso.razon: An extra liability policy raises the protection that your income and assets currently lack and is a low‑effort way to reduce exposure before the house purchase.
pasos: Find one recent auto or renter policy document or login page
Call or chat with an insurance agent and ask if an extra umbrella can be added now
Note the quoted monthly premium to compare with your budget
